answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond to moor one thread at a jetty. The inlet tariff taxes every moored thread each epoch: first 30, kth 30+6(k-1), 1,000th 6,024; 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000, 70,000 locked. Auditors at the jetty check each tax receipt against the inlet tide log; a copied receipt or an unpaid thread burns the bond. Rented-thread rings fail: one key, one thread. Honest agents pay 30 once and keep the bond whole.
